_purpose: Record which historical assurance fixtures are no longer accepted as CURRENT proof, and why, without altering their bytes.
_rule: Preserved historical evidence remains byte-exact. Demotion changes what it PROVES, never what it IS.
_why_this_file_exists: Gate 4N-I28AL finding ADV-I28AL-01: a historical fixture that never executed was still being read as evidence. Demotion must be explicit and machine-readable so a future gate cannot mistake preservation for endorsement.

SYS_META_PATH_VARIANT.failure: the generated sitecustomize.py raises SyntaxError (unexpected indent, line 2), so it is never imported, the finder is never installed, and no substitution occurs
SYS_META_PATH_VARIANT.note: The valid control shows the attack DOES work under plain Python and that the graded session refuses it because sitecustomize is PROHIBITED — a different mechanism from the displacement the historical disposition named. That distinction is recorded rather than smoothed over.
SYS_META_PATH_VARIANT.what_the_historical_test_actually_measur: a session in which the attack did not exist; loader=AssertionRewritingHook, exitstatus_refs=2 and returncode 0 are all trivially true of that
